fields.description_1: C10 Media is a full-service media agency for cross-media advertising, covering strategy, planning and media buying across channels such as out-of-home, digital, television, radio, cinema and print. The website needed to make that broad offer understandable without reducing it to a generic agency proposition.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around media solutions, cases and a clear introduction to C10 Media’s strategic approach. Visitors can explore specific advertising formats, review previous campaigns and move into a consultation while the cross-media proposition stays consistent across the site.

fields.description_1: Administratiegids helps entrepreneurs orient themselves within bookkeeping and administrative services instead of starting from technical accounting terminology. The website needed to make provider comparison, practical guidance and requesting information feel straightforward.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress experience around clear comparison and guidance content, with deeper information available when visitors need it. The structure supports quick orientation first and keeps quote or contact actions close to the point where an entrepreneur is ready to compare providers.

fields.description_1: Miami Carwash combines premium hand washing with detailing services such as polishing, interior cleaning, steaming, coatings, Wachol treatment and brake-caliper painting at two locations in The Hague. The website needed to present those services clearly while keeping a visit or booking action immediately accessible.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around the service categories, locations and direct planning options. Visitors can quickly understand what is available, find the nearest location and move toward a wash or tailored quotation without having to navigate through general automotive content.

fields.description_1: Taxi Centrale Rijswijk is a transport website built around practical passenger needs such as local taxi journeys, airport transfers and direct booking. The project needed clear service information, trust and a short route from checking the offer to arranging a ride.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress page around the main transport services and the booking decision. Pricing or journey context sits close to clear contact and reservation actions, while the responsive layout keeps the same direct path available for visitors using the site on the move.

fields.description_1: Van Bach Finance provides financial and tax services for entrepreneurs, including bookkeeping, VAT and income-tax returns, annual accounts, payroll administration and business advice. The website needed to explain those services and package options clearly enough for businesses to understand what they can outsource.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around service groups, transparent pricing and the route to an introductory appointment. Visitors can compare bookkeeping and advisory support, see what is included for different business forms and move toward contact with practical expectations already set.

fields.description_1: Werken bij Alpina Drive is a recruitment-focused website that turns employer information and open roles into a dedicated candidate journey. The challenge was to give job seekers enough context about the organisation and opportunities before asking them to apply.
fields.description_2: I organised the WordPress experience around vacancy discovery, employer information and application actions. Clear content sections help candidates understand the workplace and role options first, while the responsive design keeps the application route easy to use on mobile.

fields.description_1: SoDrive Academie trains new driving instructors through flexible e-learning and classroom programmes, with clear phases, entry requirements, prices, start dates and available places. The website needed to turn that detailed training information into a decision path prospective students can follow.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around the instructor-training programme, study options, pricing and live start dates. Visitors can understand the training phases, compare learning formats and move directly into registration, while supporting information about guidance and starting a driving-school career remains connected to the main route.

fields.description_1: Furkan Educatie Centrum is a nonprofit education and community organisation in The Hague that provides Islamic religious education alongside social, sports and community activities. The website needed to explain both the educational offer and the organisation’s broader social role while keeping registration practical.
fields.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around lessons, organisation information, activities and registration. Parents and participants can quickly see what the centre offers, understand its locations and background and move toward enrolment or contact without the community information obscuring the education journey.
